orderings.Relaxed: atomic access only; no additional cross-location synchronization
orderings.Acquire: load side acquires; on RMW the store side is Relaxed
orderings.Release: store side releases; on RMW the load side is Relaxed
orderings.AcqRel: Acquire load side + Release store side for RMW
orderings.SeqCst: applicable acquire/release behavior plus participation in a single order of SeqCst operations

operation_constraints.note: Acquire weakens store half; Release weakens load half

race_rules: data race = conflicting non-synchronized accesses with at least one non-atomic access
failed compare_exchange is not a write
non-synchronized conflicting atomic accesses must be disjoint, exact-same-range/same-size, or both reads
